# Capability matrix

**Default probe, no password and no optional backend.** Generated by
`tests/capability_probe.py`. Every `exact` count is a byte-for-byte
comparison against the payload the fixture was built from.

This table is the *unattended* lane picture. It is not the full feature
set on `main`:

- ZipCrypto and 7z AES remain `REFUSED` here because the probe does not
  supply a password. They extract when the caller passes a password and,
  for 7z AES, selects `--backend py7zr`.
- RAR compressed fixtures (`rar4_normal`, `rar5_normal`) stay HOST or
  REFUSED. Those fixture payloads are opaque/synthetic; a HOST success
  would not prove an in-tree RAR codec.
- PPMd/Zstd 7z rows say HOST in the old registry wording; the built-in
  reader refuses them unless an explicit optional backend supports them.

Measured native-kernel numbers live in `docs/RESEARCH_REPORT.md` and
`results/native_research_benchmark.json`, not in this matrix.

| ZIP | 6 | 11/11 | 1 |
| 7z | 10 | 21/21 | 3 |
| RAR | 7 | 6/6 | 5 |
| LZ4 | 11 | 11/11 | 0 |
